conflictRows.oldValue: UA p. 23 explicitly continues climbing, but describes move silently, hide, hear noise, and read languages as retained from fifth level. Their later progression is ambiguous; no automatic increases are supplied here.
conflictRows.newValue: UA p.23 explicitly freezes pick pockets, opening locks, and finding/removing traps at fifth-level ability, and reading magical writings is never gained. It says the acrobat retains move silently, hide in shadows, hear noise, and read languages acquired through fifth level, while climb walls increases with experience level. UA p.25 generally treats the acrobat as a thief except as indicated. These passages do not expressly give a new progression for the four retained abilities; no categorical freeze or automatic increases are supplied here.
conflictRows.reason: Retain literal stopped skills, retained abilities, explicit climbing growth and UA25 carryover without inventing a freeze or automatic progression.

conflictRows.oldValue: The printed text says the listed ranks are “indicated or lower”; this conflicts with the implied hierarchy of the rites, so minimum-rank wording remains unresolved.
conflictRows.newValue: UA p.41 prints that a druid of the indicated or lower level can cast each listed rite. Initiation is performed on a druid beginning seventh-level advancement; pp.41–42 say the recipient usually seeks another druid of seventh or higher level to perform it, with unusual self-casting allowed. Preserve the printed general wording and this rite-specific procedure.
conflictRows.reason: Include the rite-specific caster procedure on the continuation; retire the contradiction inferred from hierarchy alone.
